description: validate_path_with_profile (lib.rs:874) overwrites policy.current_time_unix with now_unix after calling profile.policy(now_unix), saying 'prevents a buggy Profile from silently using the wrong clock in release builds'. The comment is correct but slightly misleading: a Profile that correctly implements the contract already sets current_time_unix = now_unix inside policy(), so the overwrite is a defense-in-depth measure for incorrect implementations, not a required correctness step. The comment should clarify that this is a belt-and-suspenders guard, not compensation for a known bug — as currently worded it implies existing Profile impls might be buggy. Minor documentation clarity fix.
title: pkix-path: validate_path_with_profile overwrites current_time_unix but comment misstates purpose
